subject: Customer Onramp Briefing — scheduling, tech preflight, and attendees
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Ward <sylvia.ward@acmeinc.com>; Mike Lopez <mike.lopez@acmeinc.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer Onramp Briefing — scheduling, tech preflight, and attendees

Hi Sylvia / Mike —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference. We're ready to run the onramp briefing and want to lock a time that works for your core stakeholders and network folks. Proposed plan: a 90-minute "Onramp Briefing" (overview + roles + 30-min tech preflight) followed by optional 30-min breakout slots for SSO and data flow.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Mon 12/13: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Tue 12/14: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30

Attached is a draft agenda and an attendee roster template — please confirm who should be on the main call and who should join the tech preflight. We also need a point of contact for procurement (invoice and SOW) and a network contact for the preflight (IP/egress whitelist if required).

Stephanie (cc) will own bridge and hosting; I'll own the agenda and sequencing. Priyom will run the run-of-show and breakout owners.

Meeting links and a calendar invite will follow once we confirm a slot.

Next steps for you: reply with the preferred window and attendees, and upload any compliance questionnaires you want us to review before the call.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Success
Redwood Inference
Attachments: onramp_draft_agenda.pdf, attendee_roster_v1.xlsx

From: Sylvia Ward <sylvia.ward@acmeinc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Lopez <mike.lopez@acmeinc.com>; procurement@acmeinc.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Customer Onramp Briefing — scheduling, tech preflight, and attendees

Hi Ben —

Thanks — Tue 12/14 09:00–10:30 PST works best for our stakeholders. Please include:
- Sylvia Ward (Product Lead)
- Mike Lopez (Infra Lead)
- Priya Shah (Security, priya.shah@acmeinc.com)
- Tom Rivera (Network, tom.rivera@acmeinc.com) — critical for the preflight
- Procurement (procurement@acmeinc.com) to confirm invoicing timeline

I've attached our SOC2 questionnaire (acme_soc2_questions.pdf) — could you confirm who should receive this? Also, do you need specific IPs to whitelist ahead of the tech check?

Appreciate it — looking forward to the run-of-show.

— Sylvia
Sylvia Ward | Head of Product, Acme, Inc.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Ward <sylvia.ward@acmeinc.com>; Mike Lopez <mike.lopez@acmeinc.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com; stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com; rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 12:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Customer Onramp Briefing — scheduling, tech preflight, and attendees

Sylvia — perfect, thanks. Confirming Tue 2027-12-14 09:00–10:30 PST as the Onramp Briefing. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=onramp-acme-20271210 (placeholder).

Bridge: Stephanie Nguyen will be the meeting owner and bridge host. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=onramp (shared in invite).

Tech preflight: 30-minute slot on Tue 12/14 at 08:15–08:45 PST (please have Tom Rivera or another network engineer join). For preflight we typically validate:
- egress/whitelist IPs and ports
- SSO test account + SP metadata if using SAML
- Sample payloads and endpoint reachability

IPs to whitelist (public): 34.120.12.8, 34.120.12.9 — let us know if you require a CIDR instead. If you'd prefer an alternate preflight time we can move it earlier on Mon 12/13.

I've attached an updated attendee roster (attendee_roster_v1.xlsx). Priyom — can you take the run-of-show doc and add breakout owners for SSO and data flow? Rishi — please prepare a short slide on expected throughput/cost profile.

Thanks — invite will go out shortly.

Ben

I'll add the preflight checklist to the calendar invite and DM Tom Rivera to confirm the network seat.

— Priyom

A couple quick asks:
- Can you confirm the Zoom meeting will be recorded and where the recording will be stored?
- If you can share the Confluence link to the run-of-show in the invite, that would be helpful for our attendees.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to it.

— Sylvia
